groups.title: Shopify listings
groups.intro: Store data only you can confirm. Say yes and I make the change in Shopify Admin, all in one batch. First photos stay as they are.

items.title: Tubogas Dome Ring: Silver shows a gold photo
items.body: When a shopper picks Silver, every photo is the gold ring, because no silver photo exists.
options: Hide Silver until a silver photo exists
Make a silver photo with Higgsfield (2 credits, then you approve it)

items.title: Triple Dawn Cuff has no size at all
items.body: No size photo and no measurement in the description. Send me the inner diameter, opening and width, or say I may take them from the supplier sheet.

items.title: Roman Numeral Trio Ring US 9 costs ₹1,900; the other sizes cost ₹1,899
items.body: Also, 19 active pieces have no MRP (compare-at price), so they show no saving.
options: Set US 9 to ₹1,899 and leave the MRPs
Set US 9 to ₹1,899; I'll send the 19 MRPs

items.title: 10 pieces give their size only inside the size photo
items.body: Heartline Paperclip, Pearl Legacy, Lumière Oval necklace and bracelet, Verdant Cushion Studs, Baguette Halo Drops, Petite Square Huggies, Petite Bow Studs, Pearl Circlet Studs, Prism Cluster Studs Silver. I would copy the size from each size photo into a SIZE line in its description.

items.title: Coating wording doesn't match on 4 pieces
items.body: Rose Verdant Band's badge leaves out 'rose'. Solitaire Drop Huggies, Watch Link Strap Bracelet and Lotus Pear Drop Studs have no PVD line, and their badge and details use different wording.
options: Yes, add the PVD line to the 3 descriptions

items.title: Photo descriptions for Google and screen readers
items.body: 77 photos on 36 listings have no description. 7 say 'catalog-square', and Golden Duet Ring's says 'JDR0104342'. Heartbead Bracelet is tagged 'Rhodium Plated', but its copy says gold coated.
options: Yes, write them all and fix the Heartbead tag

groups.title: Business decisions
groups.intro: These change what shoppers are told, so the call is yours.

items.title: Returns: which is true?
items.body: Product pages promise 7-day returns if a piece doesn't suit. The returns policy allows returns for defects only. Whichever you choose, I'll make the other match.
options: Something else (write it in the note)

items.title: Cash on delivery and prepaid discount
items.body: The bag no longer shows a COD fee and COD orders carry none. Paying online takes 5% off on top of Buy 2 / Buy 3, and the bag doesn't show that 5%.
options: Keep it this way, and show the 5% in the bag
Keep it this way, don't show it
Bring back a COD fee (write the amount in the note)

items.title: Business address
items.body: The site's hidden data, the Contact page and Shopify give three different addresses. Which one is public? If it's a home address, I'll leave the street out of Google's data.
options: I'll write the address in the note

items.title: Brand name for jewellery
items.body: Product pages tell Google the brand is 'Naira Flore'. Shopify (and so the Meta and Google feeds) say 'Naira Petite'.

items.title: www.nairaflore.com should redirect permanently
items.body: www sends a temporary redirect to nairaflore.com, so every catalogue ad click takes an extra hop. A permanent (301) redirect is set in Lovable's domain settings, not in the code.

items.title: Press Publish after Shopify price changes
items.body: The pages Google and ad clicks see first keep the prices from the last Publish (27 Oct). 4 pieces are already out of date. Publishing in Lovable fixes them now. I can also add a check that tells you when Shopify and the site disagree.
options: I'll Publish now, and add the check

groups.title: Drive photos held back
groups.intro: 5 photos from your Drive folder that I didn't place.

items.title: Photos #18 and #69: a plain gold cable cuff with ball ends
items.body: No listing matches it. It looks like the Torsade Pearl Cuff without its pearls.
options: It's a new piece; I'll send the details
Put it on Torsade Pearl Cuff

items.title: Photos #7, #72 and #73: the silver tubogas ring on a black disc
items.body: These could be the silver photos Tubogas Dome Ring is missing (see C06), but the black disc doesn't match the other photos.
options: Use one, cleaned up with Higgsfield (2 credits)

items.title: Clarté Baguette Bracelet in Silver went to Draft
items.body: Someone set it to Draft on 28 Oct at 09:44, so it's off the site. It wasn't this session.

groups.title: Try-on portal
groups.intro: The portal is built and tested here, and it isn't on the site. Nothing in it can run until you do the Lovable steps.
blockers: Turn on Lovable AI. That creates the key the try-on uses.
Turn OFF "AI app context". It's on by default and keeps every request, selfies included, for 90 days.
Ask Lovable support how long they and Google keep uploaded photos, so the privacy page can say so.
Set a Lovable AI usage limit that blocks at the cap.
Ask Lovable to apply the database migration.
Publish the try-on privacy section before switching the try-on on.
Approve each piece's test renders (needs about 115 Higgsfield credits).
Run the photo-reference check before each Publish.
Check the Lovable preview, then run a 1–2 week hidden pilot before adding the 'Try it on' button.

items.title: Lovable plan
items.body: Will you turn on Lovable AI, and which Lovable plan are you on?
options: I'll write it in the note

items.title: Budget and limits
items.body: About ₹12–14 per try-on (estimate), against pieces at ₹999–2,449. Limits: 5 per phone, 30 per internet connection, 100 a day (about $16 a day at the cap, $28 at worst), plus a usage limit that blocks.

items.title: About 115 Higgsfield credits for test renders
items.body: Renders on made-up model photos (never a real person's) to certify each of the 20 pieces before it goes in the try-on.

items.title: Who certifies, and the pass mark
items.body: Will you approve each piece yourself? Is '18 of 20 pieces pass on both test models' the bar?

items.title: Bold Nocturne Chain link size
items.body: The size card says 10 mm. The description says 11.7 mm.

items.title: Ear cuffs: where they sit
items.body: Is 'middle ridge of the ear' the outer rim (helix) or the inner ridge (conch)?

items.title: Launch shape
items.body: A hidden pilot first, then the 'Try it on' button, or the button from day one?

items.title: When a render fails the likeness check
items.body: Strict: it's never shown (about $0.14 still spent). Log: it's shown with a label while we measure.

items.title: Stand-ins if a piece sells out during the pilot
items.body: May Pearl Nugget Hoops, Molten Wave Ear Cuff or Baguette Tennis Necklace replace it, after certification?

items.title: Measuring lift
items.body: Hide the button from 20% of shoppers for two weeks to measure the lift in sales, or show it to everyone?

items.title: Product pages: 2 more small files
items.body: With try-on off, product pages now load 2 more small files (+1.2 KB in all, 27 → 29 requests), because the try-on shares them.
options: Keep them in the product page's file

items.title: Android Back during a try-on
items.body: Pressing Back while cropping or waiting leaves the site, and a render that's running still counts.
options: Back returns to the previous step

items.title: Where the test photos live
items.body: The automated test and its 650 KB of made-up photos: in the shop's code, or on the separate tools branch?

items.title: Cushion Halo sizes in the try-on
items.body: The try-on shows the product page's US 5–9 choice (US 6 picked) and names the size on the button.

items.title: Save photo
items.body: In Instagram and other in-app browsers, 'Save photo' opens a press-and-hold view, as it already does on iPhone.

items.title: Bot check
items.body: Leave the try-on without a bot check (as now), or add Cloudflare's invisible one? That adds a Cloudflare script.

items.title: A site-wide connection hint
items.body: The site sets up its connection to Shopify's image server the wrong way for images. Fixing it changes every page, so I left it.
options: Fix it (goes in the next review batch)
